name: naPorta
what: We go where GPS gives up. naPorta is Brazil’s first social-impact logtech, connecting e-commerce to underserved communities where traditional delivery networks fall short. Combining technology, local delivery partners and our own operations, we make last-mile logistics more efficient, inclusive and reliable—ensuring every package reaches the customer’s door.
